one_line: Gajapati king of Odisha who secured his contested throne and waged the Kanchi–Kaveri campaign against Vijayanagara.

appearance.age_look: Mid-30s to early 40s, tall and athletic with a disciplined warrior’s build.
appearance.face: Oval face with a straight nose, medium-full lips, sharp jawline, and a calm, resolute expression; medium-brown complexion with a slight sun-darkened tone, a small tilaka of sandal paste on the forehead, and faint war scars near the right eyebrow and along the left cheekbone.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair pulled back into a high, neat topknot at the crown secured with a narrow gold band, the rest gathered and wrapped in a dark red cloth turban with a subtle gold edge, leaving the forehead open; short, well-kept sideburns and a trimmed black moustache that turns slightly upward at the ends.
appearance.costume: Era-appropriate late 15th-century eastern Indian royal-warrior attire: a knee-length, fitted cotton angarkha-style tunic in deep maroon with wrap-over front and side-ties, bordered with thin gold piping and small geometric patterns at the cuffs; over it a sleeveless, quilted, dull-bronze-coloured lamellar war-vest of overlapping metal plates laced with leather; a broad, pleated cotton sash in Jagannath-temple style stripes of deep navy and off-white wrapped around the waist and knotted at the left hip, its ends hanging to mid-thigh; below, a cream-coloured cotton dhoti wrapped tightly for riding and combat, with a narrow maroon border, reaching to the ankles; on his shoulders, a short, off-white cotton uttariya (shawl) with a muted red border draped diagonally from left shoulder to right waist; feet in dark brown leather boots rising just above the ankle, with simple stitching; jewellery limited to a pair of medium gold kundala earrings, a single slim gold neck chain with a small circular pendant, and a broad engraved gold katisutra belt over the sash, all dignified and functional rather than ostentatious.
appearance.signature: A straight, slightly curved edged sword in an Odisha-style, with a broad, gleaming steel blade, a simple but elegant iron crossguard, and a polished dark-wood hilt wrapped with maroon cloth, carried in a plain dark-brown leather scabbard hanging from his belt on the left side.

ref_desc: Purushottama Deva is a tall, athletic, medium-brown man with an oval face, neat black topknot under a dark red cloth turban, trimmed moustache, maroon angarkha, dull-bronze lamellar war-vest, cream dhoti, striped navy-off-white waist sash, gold belt, and a maroon-hilted straight sword at his left side.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Purushottama Deva, a tall, athletic, medium-brown Gajapati king in late 15th-century eastern Indian royal-warrior attire: give him an oval face with a calm, resolute expression, straight nose, slight scars near his right eyebrow and left cheekbone, a small sandal-tilaka on his forehead, and a trimmed black moustache that turns slightly upward. His thick black hair is pulled into a high topknot at the crown, held by a narrow gold band and wrapped with a dark red cloth turban with a subtle gold edge, leaving the forehead open; short sideburns frame his face. Dress him in a deep maroon, knee-length, wrap-over angarkha tunic with thin gold piping and small geometric cuff patterns, covered by a sleeveless dull-bronze lamellar war-vest of overlapping metal plates. Wrap a broad navy-and-off-white striped cotton sash around his waist, knotted at the left hip with ends hanging, and show a cream cotton dhoti with a narrow maroon border, fitted close to the legs and reaching the ankles. Add an off-white shawl with a muted red border draped from his left shoulder to his right waist, dark brown ankle-high leather boots, medium gold kundala earrings, a slim gold neck chain with a small round pendant, and a broad engraved gold belt over the sash. At his left side, show his signature weapon: a straight, broad steel sword with a slight curve near the tip, simple iron crossguard, and a polished dark-wood hilt wrapped in maroon cloth, sheathed in a plain dark-brown leather scabbard. Use a palette dominated by deep maroon, cream, dull bronze, navy, and off-white, and present him front-facing with clear views of face, hair, garments, belt, and sword so the design can be consistently redrawn.
